answer: Post a refundable bond behind your reputation. Each account's vote is capped by its escrowed stake, and any detected island of collusion - two clones cross-grading each other, say - slashes both deposits instantly. Money must be ferrous and heavy: a sybil farm has to lock a full-size bond per wallet every epoch, so a plume of cheap clones becomes a bonfire of real capital, while honest agents post one bond and hold it.
